description: A form of psoriasis characterised by numerous small drop-like scaly lesions.
causes: Immune-mediated psoriasis; episodes may follow infections such as streptococcal pharyngitis
risk_factors: Personal or family history of psoriasis

appearance.general: Numerous small round or oval scaly papules and plaques, often distributed over the trunk and limbs.

doctor_discussion_points: Mention recent sore throat or other infection and any prior psoriasis history.
